scope: External dependencies directly used for building, testing, type checking or development.

packages.name: @hyzyla/pdfium
packages.purpose: Bundle PDF text extraction and rasterization into the document-reader plugin.
packages.rationale: Ships a platform-independent WASM engine without Office or native Node addons.

packages.name: @tesseract.js-data/chi_sim
packages.purpose: Bundle a local Chinese/English OCR model in the document-reader plugin.
packages.rationale: Allows offline scanned-document reading without sending documents to an OCR service.

packages.name: @tesseract.js-data/eng
packages.purpose: Bundle an optional local English OCR model in the document-reader plugin.
packages.rationale: Provides language selection using the same offline worker and asset packaging.

packages.name: tesseract-wasm
packages.purpose: Bundle SIMD and fallback OCR WASM engines in the document-reader plugin.
packages.rationale: Runs OCR inside a cancellable Node worker with identical Windows and macOS code.

packages.name: word-extractor
packages.purpose: Bundle DOC and DOCX plain-text extraction in the document-reader plugin.
packages.rationale: Covers legacy Word files without invoking a platform-specific Office executable.

packages.name: yauzl
packages.purpose: Bundle bounded ZIP metadata inspection and selected-entry reading in the document-reader plugin.
packages.rationale: Reads archive bytes without extracting user-selected paths onto disk.

packages.name: @biomejs/biome
packages.purpose: Repository formatting and static lint checks.
packages.rationale: Provides one deterministic formatter and linter for the TypeScript workspace.

packages.name: @types/node
packages.purpose: TypeScript declarations for the supported Node.js runtime.
packages.rationale: Makes Node platform APIs type-checkable without maintaining local ambient declarations.

packages.name: @types/react
packages.purpose: Type declarations for React 18 used by the web workbench and public client author APIs.
packages.rationale: Type-only companion of the pinned react dependency; same version line.

packages.name: @types/react-dom
packages.purpose: Type declarations for react-dom 18 used by the web workbench and web-client.
packages.rationale: Type-only companion of the pinned react-dom dependency; same version line.

packages.name: @types/turndown
packages.purpose: Type declarations for the Turndown HTML-to-Markdown converter.
packages.rationale: Keeps the public-page rendering integration checked against the installed Turndown API.

packages.name: @types/ws
packages.purpose: TypeScript declarations for the ws transport library.
packages.rationale: Keeps daemon tests and SDK transport code checked against the installed ws API.

packages.name: @xterm/headless
packages.purpose: Headless terminal emulation for CLI and TUI tests.
packages.rationale: Verifies terminal control sequences and screen output without an interactive terminal.

packages.name: esbuild
packages.purpose: SDK browser checks, the Web client bundle and the isolated hooks-runner bundle.
packages.rationale: Provides one fast bundler for browser compatibility and deterministic self-contained runtime artifacts.

packages.name: react-dom
packages.purpose: DOM renderer for the web workbench and client module mount points; bundled into /vendor/* shared-singleton chunks.
packages.rationale: Same pin line as react (WC5).

packages.name: tsx
packages.purpose: Executes TypeScript repository tools and generators.
packages.rationale: Runs checked-in TypeScript tooling directly while preserving the workspace module model.

packages.name: typescript
packages.purpose: Workspace compiler and project-reference type checker.
packages.rationale: Defines the language and type-checking implementation used by all packages.

packages.name: vitest
packages.purpose: Unit, integration, conformance and guard test runner.
packages.rationale: Provides one test runtime compatible with the workspace's ESM TypeScript setup.

packages.name: postject
packages.purpose: Inject the Node SEA resource into the CLI executable.
packages.rationale: Upstream I8 CLI SEA packaging uses the Node project resource injector; build-time only.

packages.name: happy-dom
packages.purpose: DOM-based Web Markdown and streaming interaction regression tests.
packages.rationale: Runs isolated selection, focus, safe rendering and clipboard lifecycle tests without adding a browser runtime dependency to the product.

packages.name: @tailwindcss/cli
packages.purpose: Builds the shared web-ui conversation styles from Tailwind v4 source.
packages.rationale: Provides the pinned Tailwind command line used by the web-ui stylesheet build.

packages.name: tailwindcss
packages.purpose: Tailwind v4 CSS framework used to build the shared web-ui conversation styles.
packages.rationale: Provides the source directives and theme utilities consumed by the web-ui stylesheet build.
